# Mahmoud Hawa (محمود حوا)

> IT leader based in Saudi Arabia offering IT Management as a Service (إدارة تقنية المعلومات كخدمة): senior technology leadership and decision support for businesses that need it without a full-time IT executive.

## Services
- IT strategy and technology decisions: roadmaps, priorities, budgets
- ERP and business applications: selection, RFPs, implementation oversight (SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business One, Oracle)
- Vendor and contract management: evaluation, negotiation support, delivery follow-up
- IT governance and AI adoption: policies, controls, safe use of AI tools
- Business analysis and process improvement; BI as a supporting service

## Who it's for
Small and mid-size companies in Saudi Arabia and the GCC that are growing, changing systems, or lack a senior IT lead.
